title: What are people using to build 3D environments?
author: pablomakinggames
selftext:
I'm sure this question has been answered in some way shape or form, so forgive me.

What tools are folks using to generate 3D environments? I've been tinkering with generating small geometric environments by just writing Blender python scripts, using Sonnet (which might be why it's so shit). The results are rather lackluster though and require a lot of iteration to get right.

What tools or applications are folks using to generate more robust 3D environments? What I'm currently doing just to try things out is trying to recreate the interior of the Silo (TV show). Mainly just the central shaft, stairs, and some basic platforms/levels.

Up until now I've been mostly been tinkering with top down gameplay using Godot to varying degrees of success and want to try to build something a little more interesting.

comments.author: ACA2021
comments.body: Yeah, I wouldn't have Sonnet build the whole environment in one shot. For something like the Silo I'd let it handle the basic shaft/floors/stairs, then use Tripo for stuff like railings, doors, pipes, machinery and just drop those into Blender.
